content: The guidelines provided by the American Diabetes Association (ADA) are tailored to address diabetes care across various age groups. These age groups include children under the age of 10, adolescents aged 12 to 17, adults aged 18 to 64, and older adults aged 65 and above. The recommendations encompass the management of type 1 diabetes, type 2 diabetes, gestational diabetes, and hyperglycemia.
